Student Posed as Delhi Police Officer to Block X Accounts

A Class 12 student allegedly posed as a Delhi Police officer and sent fake orders to X (formerly Twitter) to block accounts. The student has been apprehended. The Delhi Police have filed an FIR regarding the forged notices that sought to block the X accounts of rights groups.
